notes.title: Patch 1.0.11 ... Now fully playable
notes.content:
This game is now complete barring any bugs that players may find.

Hooray! I'm just one person making all this and I'm pretty happy to have it in such a complete state.

notes.title: Patch
notes.content:
New patch further balances enemy deployments and improves performance there.
This one also changes the way surfaces are managed and hopefully resolve some resolution issues.

notes.title: Beta Patch
notes.content:
Almost ... there ...

This patch fixes a few smaller issues:

[list]
[*] Steam Api connection didn't play well with Android
[*] Minor dialogue changes
[*] Pathing corrections at the Docks and Library levels
[*] Balance adjustment to final level (just a little harder thanks)
[/list]

notes.title: Beta version available
notes.content:
Warmonger: Sins of the Naga is now in Beta test :p

This build fixes the following bugs:

[*] Full-screen
[*] Completed dialogue
[*] Tweaks to game balance, spawn rates
[/list]

Known Bugs:
